# Conditional fulfillment semantics

Adopt the [assessment contract](../../standard/assessment/requirement-and-need-fulfillment.md) as the resolution of EOM-03/F3 within the Execution and Operating Model standard. Report the criterion result as met, unmet or unknown. Keep the extent of achievement, required and examined conditions, evidence limits and acceptance decision distinguishable. Full, partial and none describe an identified extent; uncertain extent remains explicit.

Adopt its scoped finite-count rule, treatment of missing and conflicting evidence, sample-to-population limits, qualitative judgments and assessment changes over time. The minimum information is a reading contract that may use linked records; it does not mandate duplicated frontmatter or a universal storage format.

This acceptance is limited to the assessment contract. The whole standard remains under development; EOM-02 and other unresolved conceptual findings retain their separate scope, and detailed implementation and verification methods remain deferred.
